QuestInfo.name: Honor of the Resistance
QuestInfo.0: #p2151003# of Edelstein has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: #p2151003# wants you to hone your skills as a Resistance fighter by joining #bBattle Mode#k. If you can achieve #bRank 9#k, you should have nothing to fear from the Black Wings. Talk to #b#p9070004##k in any city to join Battle Mode.
QuestInfo.2: #p2151003# congratulated you for reaching Rank 9. You should aim for a higher rank to better prepare to fight the Black Wings.

0.0: Hello, #h0#. I realize you're busy, but I've heard some interesting rumors lately... Have you heard of #bBattle Mode#k?
0.1: It's a sort of festival in which warriors from all over the world challenge each other in battle. When I first heard of it, I suspected it was a trap set by the Black Wings...but I don't think that's it.
0.2: I've consulted the others, and we think this is an opportunity to test ourselves against other powerful opponents. Hence, I'd like you to participate, as well.

yes.0: I'd like you to achieve #bRank 9#k in Battle Mode. #h0#, announce yourself as a member of the Resistance, and use this opportunity to prepare for the time when we can fight back against the Black Wings.
yes.1: Talk to #b#p9070004# in any town#k when you're ready to participate in Battle Mode. Good luck.

no.0: I understand you've been training hard on your own, but as a member of the Resistance, it might help raise morale to see one of our own doing well in the arena.

1.0: You've reached Battle Mode Rank 9. You've already matched my expectations, but if you can increase your rank even further, all the better. Remember, your glory increases the morale of all Resistance members.

default.0: You haven't achieved #bBattle Mode Rank 9#k yet. We thought it was an easy enough goal...were we wrong?  Go see #b#p9070004# in any town#k to get started.
